Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human target TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (CHEMBL2362981). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Filter to assays with organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
